# Pack manifests (generated by `cargo xtask format-docs`; do not edit)

Files: `pack.ron` ([PackManifest](#packmanifest)).

`pack.ron`: what every pack declares about itself.

<a id="packmanifest"></a>

## PackManifest (`pack.ron`)

`pack.ron`: every pack's identity, whatever its kind.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `format_version` | integer | required | The pack format, `PACK_FORMAT_VERSION` (5); any other is refused ("re-import the pack"). |
| `id` | string | required | Lowercase slug, unique among installed packs, such as `"olx-mw-1-0"`. |
| `name` | string | required | Shown in menus. |
| `version` | string | required | The pack's own version, free text such as `"0.1.0"`. |
| `kind` | [PackKind](#packkind) | required | What the pack holds. |
| `authors` | list of string | required | Who made it. |
| `origin` | [Origin](#origin) (optional) | none | Where imported content came from; none for a pack made here. |
| `license` | string (optional) | none | The pack's license, such as an SPDX id. |

<a id="packkind"></a>

## PackKind (enum)

What a pack holds.

| Variant | Fields | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Mod` | — | Weapons, projectiles and physics (`docs/formats/mod.md`). |
| `Level` | — | A level (`docs/formats/level.md`). |
| `Skin` | — | A worm skin (`docs/formats/skin.md`). |
| `Theme` | — | A level theme: holes, green dirt, tiles (`docs/formats/theme.md`). |
| `Core` | — | OLX's shared game assets (`crate::core_pack::CoreDef`). |

<a id="origin"></a>

## Origin

Where imported content came from.

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | required | For example `"OpenLieroX"`. |
| `path` | string | required | Path inside the source, for example `"share/gamedir/MW 1.0"`. |
| `revision` | string | required | Source revision, for example a git commit. |
